# TE4 Season Planner

> Reference data for planning a Tennis Elbow 4 World Tour career (including Tennis Elbow Manager 2 mode) under the XKT mod profile, with the ATPWTA Patch and ATP Realistic Stats V2. Extracted from the installed mod files: TE4-ModdingSDK → XKT → ScoreBoardsByStef → ATPWTA Patch → ATP Realistic Stats V2. 470 ATP and 534 WTA events.

Values marked mod-data are read directly from ini files; values marked inferred follow a stated rule in rules.md. Travel costs, registration windows, and point tables are explained in rules.md. Guide heuristics (rest, motivation, fatigue) are separate from game data.

## Core

- [Rules and data](/game-reference/tennis-elbow/explore/rules.md): fare matrix, zones, category point tables, tax, wildcards, field strength, inferences, data issues, source hashes
- [ATP calendar by week](/game-reference/tennis-elbow/explore/atp-calendar.md): every ATP event with tier, country, zone, surface, draw, and winner points
- [WTA calendar by week](/game-reference/tennis-elbow/explore/wta-calendar.md): the same for WTA
- [Career guide tables](/game-reference/tennis-elbow/explore/guide-tables.md): the travel-cost and surface tables from the TEM2 career guide, regenerated from the calendar

- Challenger, ITF, and junior events each have a page under explore/atp/ and explore/wta/; the calendar files link every one.
